question: Should `record.sessionKey` remain a supported public channel-plugin SDK override, or should the Telegram-specific split between command dispatch and target-session recording stay behind a core-owned internal seam?
rationale: The branch documents and exports a new cross-session persistence behavior. Tests can verify mechanics, but they cannot determine the intended permanent plugin contract or its compatibility promise to external plugins.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Refactor the Telegram-only path behind a core-owned seam so external channel plugins retain one canonical session-recording contract.

options.title: Approve the SDK override
options.body: Retain and document the override as public only after an owner confirms the compatibility contract and required cross-plugin coverage.

options.title: Pause the contract change
options.body: Defer the split-session behavior until maintainers decide whether external plugins should control a record target distinct from dispatch routing.

recommendation.title: Keep it internal
recommendation.body: Refactor the Telegram-only path behind a core-owned seam so external channel plugins retain one canonical session-recording contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the related merged lifecycle work and this follow-up's proposed public contract.
